events.did: split the convoy into two vans on two possible routes, following military strategy against ambush
events.quote_anchor: It had been Noah’s idea to split the convoy. With two assets in two vans, and two possible routes

events.did: shot Noah with a tranquilizer dart at point-blank range
events.quote_anchor: a side effect of the stimulant he’d had to take, to counter the effects of the tranquilizer dart Eli had shot him with. At point-blank range.

events.did: lay on the third bench of the transport blindfolded, bound, and heavily sedated
events.quote_anchor: The younger Clarke sister lay on the third bench, the one nearest the front, blindfolded and bound, and heavily sedated.

events.did: heard an explosion burst across the comms from the other van, followed quickly by gunfire
events.quote_anchor: Just then, an explosion burst across the comms from the other van, a blare of static, followed quickly by gunfire, the melee punctuated by a single word.

events.did: came back on the comm and reported that the other transport had stopped
events.quote_anchor: Eli was about to say something when one of the agents up front came back on the comm. “The other transport has stopped.”

events.did: rose, pressed his palm to the sensor on the back door so it chirped and unlocked, and swung himself down toward the driver’s side
events.quote_anchor: Noah rose and pressed his palm to the sensor on the back door. It chirped, and unlocked, and he swung himself down, approaching the driver’s side.

events.did: reached up and took the comm out of his ear before the doctor could issue a command
events.quote_anchor: told him to reach up, and take the comm out of his ear before the doctor could issue a command.

events.did: listened when the voice told him someone had helped Mitchell Turner escape the transport, and when it whispered a name
events.quote_anchor: He listened when it told him someone had helped Mitchell Turner escape the transport in the park. When it whispered a name, not in his ears

relations.did: imagined emptying his gun into Eli’s chest but was held back by Gabriel’s will
relations.quote_anchor: When he imagined emptying his gun into the other EO’s chest, he felt Gabriel’s will like a tug on a leash.

relations.did: rode with Sydney because Dr. Gray had declared Sydney the more important target
relations.quote_anchor: since Dr. Gray had declared Sydney the more important target, they’d both ended up with her.

relations.did: explained to Eli that God has no mortal voice and is heard in our hearts and bones
relations.quote_anchor: his father had explained, with uncommon patience, that He didn’t have a mortal voice. We heard Him in our hearts, our bones.

relations.did: had been mauled by the dog, whose jaws left jagged silver lines above his collar
relations.quote_anchor: The dog’s jaws had left jagged silver lines above his collar, and it looked like one of its teeth had caught the bottom of his cheek.

numbers.quote_anchor: the space between them less than a mile at most points
